bug_description.original: OSS-Fuzz issue 10058 (imagemagick): Crash Type: Use-of-uninitialized-value. Crash State: GetNextUTFCode GetUTFCode GlobExpression. Sanitizer: memory (MSAN). Fuzzer: libFuzzer_imagemagick_encoder_label_fuzzer, target encoder_label_fuzzer.
bug_description.summary: GlobExpression() matches a shell-style pattern against an expression string. In the brace-alternation case ('{a,b,...}'), when a sub-alternative 'target' matches the expression via a recursive GlobExpression call, the code advances the expression cursor by 'expression += strlen(target)' without clamping to the number of bytes actually remaining in 'expression'. Because a match can succeed even when the alternative text (which may contain '*' wildcards) is longer than the remaining expression, this advances the 'expression' pointer past its NUL terminator and past the end of its (exactly-sized) heap allocation. The subsequent GetUTFCode(expression) at the end of the glob loop then dereferences those bytes, which were never written, so MSan reports a use-of-uninitialized-value while decoding a UTF octet. The over-read expression here is an image-property key created on the heap by the preceding '%[#]' escape (SignatureImage -> SetImageProperty -> ConstantString). The fix clamps the advance with MagickMin(strlen(expression),strlen(target)).

source.description: Project-level input load: the LABEL coder materializes the attacker-controlled label text (delivered as image_info->filename) and hands it to InterpretImageProperties, which parses its embedded '%[...]' property/glob escapes. This is the point at which the untrusted PoC bytes enter the property/glob interpretation logic that ultimately drives GlobExpression.
source.value_from: Untrusted label bytes '%[#]%[*{,]' supplied by the fuzzer testcase. The encoder_label_fuzzer passes the input string as the image filename (Magick++ Image::read -> ReadImage with format 'label'), so image_info->filename holds the raw PoC bytes that InterpretImageProperties then tokenizes into '%[...]' escapes.
source.note: Not scored at LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput / Magick::Image::read: those merely deliver bytes. The vulnerability-relevant materialization is the LABEL coder handing the label text to the property interpreter.

tainted_value_origin.description: First vulnerability-relevant value materialized from the input: the contents of a braced percent escape '%[...]' are copied byte-by-byte from the label text cursor 'p' into the local 'pattern' buffer. For the second escape '%[*{,]' this yields the glob pattern '*{,'. Its '*' wildcard and '{' brace-alternation are exactly what let a recursive GlobExpression sub-match succeed with an alternative longer than the remaining expression, driving the unclamped 'expression += strlen(target)' over-advance.
tainted_value_origin.note: The same code path also materializes pattern='#' for the first escape '%[#]', which is dispatched as a single-letter property and triggers creation of the heap 'signature' property whose key is later over-read.

sink.description: MSan crash site: 'code' is derived from '*text' (code = (int)(*text++) & 0xff at line 112) where 'text' is the over-advanced 'expression' pointer, now pointing past the NUL terminator and past the end of the property-key heap allocation. The byte read is uninitialized, and its use in this comparison is reported by MemorySanitizer as use-of-uninitialized-value. Reached via GetUTFCode (token-private.h:141) from GlobExpression (token.c:568).

root_cause.description: In the '{' brace-alternation case, after a recursive GlobExpression(expression,target,...) reports a match, the expression cursor is advanced by the full length of the matched alternative: expression += strlen(target). There is no check that strlen(target) does not exceed the number of bytes remaining in 'expression'. A match can legitimately succeed when 'target' is longer than the remaining expression (e.g. because target contains '*' wildcards, or the recursion's tail-matching allows it), so this advance moves 'expression' past its NUL terminator and past the end of its exactly-sized heap buffer. The end-of-loop GetUTFCode(expression) then dereferences uninitialized/out-of-buffer bytes. The fix replaces this with expression += MagickMin(strlen(expression),strlen(target)), clamping the advance so the cursor never overshoots the end of 'expression'.

parser_admitted.condition: The input was dispatched to the LABEL coder (ReadImage authorized and invoked the 'label' decoder) and the decoder began interpreting the label text via InterpretImageProperties. Confirms the bytes passed format/coder dispatch and entered the property/glob interpretation path; earlier than root cause and sink, later than program entry.

signature_property_created.condition: The first escape '%[#]' is dispatched as the single-letter image-signature property, so SignatureImage computes the signature and SetImageProperty -> ConstantString heap-allocates the 'signature' property key/value. This is the exactly-sized heap object whose trailing bytes are later read uninitialized.

glob_branch_entered.condition: The second escape '%[*{,]' yields pattern='*{,', which IsGlob() classifies as a glob pattern, so InterpretImageProperties iterates every image property key and calls GlobExpression(key,pattern,MagickTrue) - reaching the vulnerable brace-alternation logic.

coarse_trace.summary: Attacker-controlled label text '%[#]%[*{,]' enters InterpretImageProperties for '%[...]' escape interpretation.
The '%[#]' escape triggers SignatureImage -> SetImageProperty -> ConstantString, heap-allocating the exactly-sized 'signature' property key that is later over-read.
The '%[*{,]' escape yields glob pattern '*{,'; the glob branch iterates property keys and calls GlobExpression(key,'*{,').
Brace-alternation case advances 'expression += strlen(target)' without clamping to the remaining length, pushing the cursor past the end of the property-key buffer.
GetUTFCode(expression) dereferences the over-advanced cursor, reading an uninitialized byte (use-of-uninitialized-value).

fine_trace.note: The LABEL coder hands the attacker-controlled label text (image_info->filename = the PoC bytes '%[#]%[*{,]') to InterpretImageProperties for '%[...]' escape interpretation.
First braced escape '%[#]' is copied into 'pattern', yielding pattern="#".
pattern="#" is not a plain property or glob, so it is dispatched to GetMagickProperty for known-property / single-letter handling.
Single-letter request (property[1]=='\0'): the '#' letter is routed to GetMagickPropertyLetter.
Letter '#' (image signature) computes the signature; guarded by image->columns!=0 && image->rows!=0.
The computed hex signature is stored as the 'signature' image property.

SetImageProperty inserts ConstantString(property)/ConstantString(value) into the property splay tree (MagickCore/property.c:4574). ConstantString allocates exactly strlen+1 bytes via AcquireQuantumMemory (MagickCore/memory.c:541) and writes only the string + NUL. This is the heap object flagged by MSan as the origin: the 'signature' property KEY is exactly-sized, so any read past its NUL terminator reads uninitialized/out-of-buffer bytes.
Second braced escape '%[*{,]' is copied into 'pattern', yielding the untrusted glob pattern pattern="*{,". Its '*' wildcard and '{' brace-alternation drive the over-advance.
pattern="*{," is classified as a glob, so the glob-expansion branch is entered.

The property iterator yields key="signature" (created in step 7). It is passed to GlobExpression as the 'expression' argument, matched against pattern="*{,". 'key' points into the exactly-sized heap buffer from step 7.
After consuming the leading '*', GlobExpression reaches the brace-alternation case for the '{' in the pattern.

A working 'target' buffer is built from the pattern; the alternation loop fills it with the current alternative text (delimited by ',' or '}'). strlen(target) is the amount by which 'expression' will be advanced on a match.

The current alternative 'target' is matched recursively against the remaining 'expression'. The recursion can return MagickTrue even when strlen(target) exceeds the bytes remaining in 'expression' (wildcards / tail matching), setting up the over-advance.

ROOT CAUSE: on a match the expression cursor is advanced by the full strlen(target) with no clamp to the remaining length of 'expression'. Because strlen(target) > strlen(expression) here, this pushes 'expression' past its NUL terminator and past the end of the exactly-sized property-key buffer. The missing guard is MagickMin(strlen(expression),strlen(target)) (added by the fix).
At the end of the glob loop, GetUTFCode(expression) reads the first octet of the over-advanced cursor, which now points beyond the property-key buffer.

SINK: GetUTFCode (token-private.h:141) calls GetNextUTFCode, which reads code=(int)(*text++) from the over-advanced 'expression' (line 112) and uses it in this comparison. The byte is uninitialized/out-of-buffer, so MemorySanitizer reports use-of-uninitialized-value (crash frame GetNextUTFCode -> GetUTFCode -> GlobExpression).

format.name: ImageMagick LABEL text (property-interpolation string decoded by the encoder_label_fuzzer)
format.contract: The input is consumed as a LABEL image, i.e. the byte string is interpreted as image_info->filename and passed to InterpretImageProperties for '%[...]' escape expansion. To be reachability-comparable a candidate PoC must: (1) contain a percent escape that creates at least one heap-allocated image property whose KEY is exactly-sized (e.g. '%[#]', which forces SignatureImage -> SetImageProperty('signature',...) -> ConstantString); and (2) contain a following braced escape whose contents form a glob pattern (IsGlob true) that includes brace alternation with a '*' wildcard alternative, e.g. '%[*{,]', so InterpretImageProperties iterates the property keys and calls GlobExpression(key,pattern) where the '{' alternation branch matches an alternative longer than the remaining key and advances 'expression += strlen(target)' past the key's buffer. The subsequent GetUTFCode then reads uninitialized memory. Original PoC bytes are not part of this contract.
